G:que-relative-after-article-as-pronoun.sense: que: relative after article as pronoun

ja.rule: Japanese has no relative pronoun: the clause stands before its noun, here もの or の, the one.
Japanese has no relative pronoun: the clause stands before the noun it tells of, its verb in the plain form.
After the noun: the place or the writing where. Between two nouns, での or における.
Before the noun: this, near the speaker.
Before the noun; Japanese marks no plural here.

ja.said: the plain verb before the noun
ja.rule: The verb in its plain form stands before the noun it spells out; という may join them.
Before the adjective or adverb: so. With «que», the clause of the result follows ほど.
With は or が; left unsaid where the sentence is clear without it.
Japanese has no article.
Before the noun: its, their; of persons 彼の, 彼らの. Left unsaid where the owner is clear.
No relative pronoun: the clause stands before its noun, or a new sentence takes the noun up with それは.

G:a-to-after-a-noun-dative-direction.sense: a: to (after a noun — dative, direction)

ja.rule: After the noun: to, toward. Between two nouns, への.
Before the noun.
を for the object, に for the one it goes to; before the verb. Left unsaid where clear.
After the verb's plain form: in order to.
Japanese has no article.
Before the noun: its; of a person 彼の, 彼女の. Left unsaid where the owner is clear.
After the plain form, with a verb of urging or resolve: to do. With a verb of motion, the verb's stem and に.
Where the Spanish verb takes its object with «de», the object's を. Where «de» says from, から.
より after what is surpassed: more than. 最も before the adjective: the most. Alone, もっと: more.

G:el-article-before-a-nominalised-infini.sense: el: article before a nominalised infinitive (al + infinitive = on …-ing)

ja.rule: «al» and the infinitive: the verb's plain form and とき: on doing, when.
After the noun: without. Before a noun, のない.
After the noun: as, in the quality of. Of a likeness, のように.
As «y»: between nouns; between clauses the verb's ‑て form. Spanish writes «e» before i‑.
Japanese has no article.
After the noun: together with. Of a means, で; of a manner, をもって; toward someone, に対して.
Before the verb; of a woman, 彼女を. Left unsaid where the object is clear.

G:la-object-clitic-released-by-the-split.sense: la: object clitic (released by the split)

ja.rule: As the clitic before the verb: Spanish writes it joined to the infinitive, Japanese before the verb, or leaves it unsaid.

G:de-of-after-a-noun-relation-possession.sense: de: of (after a noun — relation, possession)

ja.rule: After the noun that owns or defines, before the noun it tells of: the order is the reverse of the Spanish.

G:de-of-after-a-noun-relation-possession.sense: de: of (after a noun — relation, possession) (coordinated)

ja.rule: Said once, after the last of the nouns that と joins: Spanish repeats «de», Japanese does not.
The whole locution «desde luego»: of course; it opens the clause.
Before the verb: to them. Left unsaid where clear.
Before the noun; Japanese marks no plural here.
Japanese has no reflexive clitic: the verb's own «se» lies in the verb chosen, often an intransitive one.
The auxiliary of the perfect: the verb's past form in た; of a state that lasts, ている.
After the noun: in, the place or the matter where something is done. Of where something is, に.
After the clause of the cause, which stands first. なぜなら opens a sentence that gives the cause after.
After what is surpassed: than.
«capaz de» and the infinitive, able to: after the verb's plain form.

G:se-passive-impersonal-se-verb-noun-phr.sense: se: passive / impersonal (se + verb + noun phrase)

ja.rule: The verb's passive form, in れる or られる; where no one acts, an intransitive verb says it too.
The whole locution «además de», after the noun: besides.
After what is said of the subject, at the end of the clause; in plain speech だ.
Before the adjective or adverb. In writing, 非常に.
Before the noun: these.
Opens the clause that gives the reason: for. Where it says «then», それでは.
The whole locution «a pesar de», after the noun: despite.
After the verb's plain form: in order to do; after its past form, because of having done.

G:los-object-clitic-released-by-the-spli.sense: los: object clitic (released by the split)

ja.rule: As the clitic before the verb; of things, それらを. Left unsaid where clear.
With «lo»: the clause stands before こと or もの, what.

G:in-de-este-modo-in-this-way.sense: in «de este modo»: in this way

ja.rule: The whole locution «de este modo»: in this way.
Before the noun: that, far from both. Of what was just named, その.
After the adjective: what is so. もの of things, こと of matters.
After the noun: by means of. Of a way through, を通って.
Before the noun: this.
«obligar a» and the infinitive: the verb's causative form, in せる or させる: to make someone do.
After the noun, at the head of its clause: in, at; は sets the place as what is spoken of.
After the clause: what, that which. Of a thing, もの; taking up a whole clause, それは.

G:in-por-si-by-itself-on-its-own-por-si-.sense: in «por sí»: by itself / on its own (por sí solo)

ja.rule: The whole locution «por sí»: by oneself, on one's own. Of a thing, それ自体で.
After the clause, before the noun it spells out: the theory that ….
With «de»: the clause, then という, then the noun.
The whole locution «bien que», after the clause it grants: although. In writing, とはいえ.
Japanese has no article; 最も before the adjective says the superlative.
The whole locution «en donde»: Japanese has no word for it; the clause stands before the noun of the place.

G:in-por-otra-parte-on-the-other-hand.sense: in «por otra parte»: on the other hand

ja.rule: The whole locution «por otra parte»: on the other hand; it opens the clause.

G:que-conjunction-after-es-adjective-es-.sense: que: conjunction after es + adjective (es cierto que)

ja.rule: After the clause, with は: «it is certain that …» is …ことは確かだ.
Before the verb; of a man, 彼を. Left unsaid where the object is clear.
The infinitive of the copula: after what is said of the subject.
After the verb's negative stem: without doing. In speech, ないで.
After each thing denied, the verb in its negative form: neither … nor.
Before the verb: to him; to her, 彼女に; to it, それに. Left unsaid where clear.
After the nouns that と joins: between, among. Of where something is, の間に.
Between nouns: or. In writing, または; between clauses, あるいは.
After the clause, before a verb of saying or thinking: that. Before other verbs, こと.
After the one who acts, with a passive verb: by.
With は or が; left unsaid where clear.

ja.form: 私たちを · 私たちに
ja.rule: を for the object, に for those it goes to; before the verb.

G:de-of-the-second-of-two-de-de.sense: de: of (the second of two: de … de)

ja.rule: As the first «de»: each owner before what it owns. In a date nothing is said: 三月二十六日.
«después de», after the noun: after. After a verb, its past form and 後で.
The whole locution «sin embargo»: however; it opens the clause.
The past of the copula, of a state that lasted; in plain speech だった.
After the noun, with a verb of being or of finding: in, at.
«cerca de», after the noun: near. Before a number, where it says «nearly», ほぼ before the number.
After の: those of, the ones of. In writing, それ.
After the noun, at the head of the sentence: in; «en segundo», secondly, is 第二に.
The whole locution «por consiguiente»: consequently; it opens the clause.
After the noun: for, for the sake of. Of the one something touches, にとって.
After the clause: the one that. Before «de», の alone.

G:in-por-esta-razon-for-this-reason.sense: in «por esta razón»: for this reason

ja.rule: The whole locution «por esta razón»: for this reason.
The whole locution «sin que», after the verb's plain form: without … doing.
Before the verb: already. With a negative verb, もう: no longer.

G:in-en-razon-de-by-reason-of.sense: in «en razón de»: by reason of

ja.rule: The whole locution «en razón de», after the noun: in the ratio of, as it stands here. Where it says «by reason of», のために.
«acabar de» and the infinitive: after the verb's past form, with だ: to have just done.
The whole locution «no solo», after the word it does not stop at: not only; も follows what is added.
Before the noun: that, far from both. Of what was just named, その.
Before «de» and an infinitive: the one of doing — the verb's plain form and こと. Of a thing, もの.
After the thing and が: there is. Of the living, いる.
After the noun or adjective said of the subject, which は marks; in plain speech だ.
As the singular: the Japanese copula marks no number.
Japanese has no article.

G:in-a-el-mismo-tiempo-at-the-same-time.sense: in «a el mismo tiempo»: at the same time

ja.rule: The whole locution «al mismo tiempo»: at the same time.
After the noun: because of. Of a feeling that moves one, から.
Of things; of women, 彼女たち. With the particle its place in the clause asks.

G:in-en-defensa-de-in-defence-of.sense: in «en defensa de»: in defence of

ja.rule: The whole locution «en defensa de», after the noun: in defence of.
